lockfile.edgeSource: The exact package records, peer contexts, snapshots, and dependency edges are frozen in the hash-bound pnpm lockfile.

installPolicy.packagePolicy: The mandatory frozen/offline install command includes --ignore-scripts, uses an owner-validated existing metadata cache, and preserves pnpm v11's default 24-hour minimum release age; no deprecated package-level build allowlist is relied upon.
installPolicy.activationBlocker: Any production native artifact still required after replacements must be separately inventoried, hash-bound, and built by an explicitly audited offline step before S2 sealing.

constraints: src/protocol may not import @modelcontextprotocol/sdk or upstream MCPHub transport modules
the private backend client may not parse or serve public HTTP
all production and development specifiers are exact versions
the materialized runtime may not resolve packages from a registry or mutable cache

closure.reason: Protocol, OAuth, ingress, policy, security, and runtime sources are concurrent inputs. The final owned-source, patch, output, and aggregate dependency closure is sealed only after both F2 joins.
